description: `review-policy` (cli.py's cmd_review_policy, no --lane) prints the effective [review_policy] values via config.render_review_policy -- the same rendering `check --verbose` shares -- plus a per-project reviewer-seat line and dispatch-budget line. No [review_policy] override and no reviewer chain here, so every value is the ReviewPolicy dataclass default, and the per-project sections fall back to their 'none configured' text. Read-only: no Herdr call.
